description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with tick labels at regular 20,000-iteration intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 intervals. Six colored solid lines (each with a faint shaded band around it) show loss decreasing over iterations: the purple “Vanilla” curve starts near the top of the axis around 3.4 at iteration 0 and declines steeply early, then more gradually, reaching roughly 2.48–2.50 by 140,000; the light-blue “StrmLLM (n=64)” curve also begins near ~3.4 and decreases quickly at first, then slowly, ending around ~2.61 at 140,000; the orange “SepLLM (n=64)” curve begins near ~3.4, drops rapidly, and continues a gradual decline to about ~2.52 by 140,000; the green “SepLLM (n=64, H)” curve follows a similar shape, starting near ~3.4 and ending around ~2.51–2.52 at 140,000; the red “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” curve starts near ~3.4 and declines to roughly ~2.50–2.51 by 140,000; and the dark-blue “SepLLM (n=128)” curve starts near ~3.4 and decreases to about ~2.50 by the final iteration, with all curves showing the steepest drop within the earliest portion of training and flatter slopes later.
